items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He mentioned to me that Lalo Schiffrin was leaving the band and asked me if I would be interested.

ctx.x: Okay. So, Moody hooked that one up for you?

Yeah. They were working at Birdland. I had just got married. They were working at Birdland. I just happened to run into Moody on Broadway. He mentioned to me that Lalo Schiffrin was leaving the band and asked me if I would be interested. Are you kidding? Of course. So I went down to Birdland to talk to Dizzy, and he hired me without ever hearing me play, just based on Moody’s recommendation. But I also think the fact that I was married may have helped. I think that he thought that maybe being married, I was a…
Diz’s repertoire is all over. You got all the Latin stuff. You got – so I guess that was just on-the-job training. You just learned it there.
